summary: Approved React kiosk implemented and locally verified; merchant ordering/payment remain outside the connected scope.

accuracy.evidence: 50 Python and7 reducer tests pass; real public photos/menu; server prices and local queue notices retained. Live merchant availability is unknown.
accuracy.improvement: Validate production catalog availability through an authorized merchant adapter.

completeness.evidence: Responsive kiosk, options/cart/quote/confirm, assistant/support/preferences/progress and guest reset implemented; deterministic async regressions pass. Full Behance reference unavailable.
completeness.improvement: Review against full reference if the owner supplies access; establish an approved visual baseline.

clarity.evidence: Vietnamese UI separates internal request, payment and merchant state. README explains memory-only guest session and rebuild commands.
clarity.improvement: Conduct moderated usability and screen-reader checks with customers.

actionability.evidence: Local preview running; source/lockfile, reproducible image pipeline, compiled assets and tested wheel supplied. Production integrations are not connected.
actionability.improvement: Connect official POS/payment adapters before live service.

conciseness.evidence: Retains existing FastAPI backend and reducer rather than adding a client state framework; installation CLI removed from runtime dependencies. Responsive CSS is substantial.
conciseness.improvement: Consolidate CSS only when recurring maintenance needs justify it.

top_improvements: Approved screenshot baseline and real-user accessibility/usability checks.
self_check: The implementation satisfies the approved local kiosk scope; do not present synthetic performance or local requests as production merchant service.
